description: Presses toward the no-escape zone for high-probability shots (fires at 40% of Rmax), cranks once well inside the enemy envelope and breaks only inside its no-escape zone or when an active missile is tracking it. Reference profile built from openly described BVR principles (shot range as a fraction of Rmax, crank to support, defend on missile warning, stay out of the enemy's no-escape zone); see docs/PUBLIC_REFERENCES.md.
